popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book XI — Odysseus meets Tyro among the dead: Poseidon in Enipeus' form, and the twin sons who will found the Aeolid lines of Iolcus and Pylos.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Aeolid stemma — Tyro as mother of Pelias and Neleus, the hinge between Salmoneus and the Argonaut generation.

popCulture.title: Tyro
popCulture.description: Daughter of Salmoneus who loved the river-god's shape — mother of Pelias and Neleus, grandmother of Jason's generation.
